title: Texts in Figma
description: The plugin takes texts straight from the service and updates the variables in the design — on click or live.
pluginHint: Sections and languages are chosen in the plugin. Texts are edited here in the service.
step2: In the Figma desktop app: Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest → {file}.
step3: Run the plugin and paste the token:
zipHint: Without the plugin — an archive for the built-in import: one file per language. Drag all the files into the Variables window: each becomes a mode, names with / become a group tree.
